meaning:
ὑπερ-φρονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.13:1 4Mac 14:11 4Mac 16:2 * ;]
1. to be overproud, high-minded (Æsch.): μὴ ὑ. παρ᾽ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν (on the paranom., see Vau., in l), Rom.12:3.
2. to overlook, think slightly of (Thuc., Plat.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For I say through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think…
